polityNote: Kenya, independent since 1963-12-12. Atoms are the 47 counties of geoBoundaries KEN ADM1 (2020, RCMRD / Africa GeoPortal, public domain). 1963-2013 the eight provinces (regions in the 1963 constitution) are the unions of the counties (= 1992 districts) each contained; the districts were split only inside provinces (statoids), so the province lines are county lines. From 2013-03-04 the 47 counties are the first level.
